objective: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

description: Please help me, <class>! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.
I need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.
Whitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!
completion: Whats! If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to Thousand Needles. We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.
I appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.
